group.Description: Study group based on suicide risk and clinical status

Levels.SR: Suicide risk: Lifetime history of suicide attempt or suicidal ideation
Levels.CC: Clinical control: Mood or anxiety disorder with no history of suicide attempt or suicidal thoughts
Levels.HV: Healthy volunteer: No history of psychiatric disorder, suicide attempt, or suicidal thoughts

primary_diagnosis.Description: Primary psychiatric diagnosis confirmed using the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM Psychiatric Disorders (SCID)

cmars_madrs_tot.LongName: Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale Total Score
cmars_madrs_tot.Description: Clinician-rated measure of depressive symptom severity; higher scores indicate greater impairment

cmars_hamd_24_tot.LongName: 24-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale Total Score
cmars_hamd_24_tot.Description: Clinician-rated measure of depressive symptom severity using the 24-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale; higher scores indicate greater impairment

cmars_hama_tot.LongName: Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale Total Score
cmars_hama_tot.Description: Clinician-rated measure of anxiety symptom severity; higher scores indicate greater impairment

ssi_total_curr.Description: Frequency of current suicidal ideation, measured using the Scale of Suicidal Ideation (SSI)

ssi_total_past.Description: Frequency of past suicidal ideation, measured using the SSI
